Our Mission

The freight industry deserves better.

Silk Route Freight Brokerage LLC was built on a simple belief: the freight industry deserves better. Better communication. Faster answers. Fairer pricing — not just for shippers, but for the carriers moving the freight too.

After watching the industry operate with inefficiency, slow response times, and one-sided pricing for years, we decided to do something about it. Silk Route launched in 2026, but the groundwork was laid over five years of planning, industry experience, and an honest conversation about what a freight brokerage should look like. The answer we kept coming back to was straightforward: be the broker you'd actually want to work with.

      Standards

      Carrier Vetting

      At Silk Route, every carrier we work with is vetted before the first load. We review FMCSA safety ratings, crash history, driver qualification records, and insurance certificates as standard practice — not as a checkbox, but because our shippers depend on us to put safe, reliable carriers on their freight.

      We do not work with carriers rated Conditional or Unsatisfactory by the FMCSA. Our documentation is current, our process is consistent, and we stand behind every carrier selection we make.

      This standard matters more than ever following the Supreme Court's unanimous ruling in Montgomery v. Caribe Transport II, LLC (May 2026), which confirmed that freight brokers can be held liable in state court for negligent carrier selection. We take that responsibility seriously.
